# Worked example: CSV export CLI

Illustrative dossier for a Python command line tool that exports stored notes.
There is no implemented application in this example. Commands, reviewer findings
and proof below demonstrate the records a real feature would require; they are
explicitly pending or illustrative, not executed acceptance evidence.

Read [brief](01_brief_csv-export.md), [architecture](02_architecture_csv-export.md),
[plan](03_plan_csv-export.md) and [progress](04_progress_csv-export.md).
All referenced leaves are included in HTML. Builders receive only the relevant
requirement/design/contract sources, while the human reads the entire dossier.

Render from the package root using the README command, or review Markdown.
HTML output is generated and ignored by Git.
